module purpose: neorv32_imem implements processor-internal instruction memory behind a request/response bus. It derives a word address from the request, either reads a pre-initialized ROM word or writes and reads a byte-writeable RAM word depending on IMEM_INIT, and returns read data plus an acknowledge response while err is tied low.

use-case flows.value: word index derived from the request address and used to select the IMEM location
byte-enabled write data stored into RAM IMEM bytes when IMEM_INIT is false
addressed IMEM word returned on read requests
acknowledge indicating request completion, read-only in the ROM build and any strobe in the RAM build
read-data enable and acknowledge cleared when rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Current IMEM word index selected for an access
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module computes the live access index with `addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2));` (line 101) and uses that value to select the addressed ROM word at line 81 and the addressed RAM bytes at lines 116, 119, 122, 125 and 128-131. If this computed index is corrupted, a read or write targets a different memory location than the request specifies, breaking access-target integrity. The alternative `addr_ff` path shown in the map is unreachable in the RTL because `alt_style_c` is a constant false (line 38), so `addr` is the live selection value in implemented builds.

conceptual assets.concept: Writable IMEM byte contents in the RAM configuration
conceptual assets.reasoning: When `not IMEM_INIT`, the module writes each RAM byte lane only under the request's write and byte-enable conditions: lines 114-125 update `mem_ram_b0`..`mem_ram_b3` from the corresponding slices of `bus_req_i.data`. Those stored bytes are later read back into `rdata` at lines 128-131 and then can reach the response data path at line 185, so the RAM operation depends on each stored byte matching the selected incoming data byte. Availability is also established after a byte has been written, because these byte arrays are edge-stored and are the live RAM data source in the implemented default style; the map's alternative-style reads through `addr_ff` are unreachable because line 38 fixes `alt_style_c` false.

conceptual assets.concept: Read data word produced for a read access
conceptual assets.reasoning: The read-out flow returns `rdata` only when the captured read qualifier is true: `rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw);` (line 176) and `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0');` (line 185). In the ROM build, `rdata` is loaded from `mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr))` at line 81; in the RAM build, its four byte lanes are loaded from `mem_ram_b0`..`mem_ram_b3` at lines 128-131. Integrity therefore requires the returned word to match the addressed memory source defined by the active build. Availability is also established under the RTL-visible read condition because a read request causes `rdata` to be captured on the clock edge and then exposed through line 185.

The module computes and stores a read/not-read decision in `rden` at line 176 and uses that decision to gate the response data at line 185. If `rden` is corrupted, the block can suppress a legitimate read result or expose a memory word when the request was not a read, so the correctness of the read-data path depends directly on this decision. Availability is also established because, with reset inactive, a request satisfying `bus_req_i.stb and not bus_req_i.rw` produces the stored qualifier on the next rising edge.

The report flow defines acknowledge as a build-dependent decision: reset forces `bus_rsp_o.ack <= '0'` (line 174), the ROM build uses `bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)` at line 178, and the RAM build uses `bus_req_i.stb` at line 180. Integrity requires the emitted acknowledge to follow those predicates so that the consumer receives the response event the flow defines. No related structural assets survive the reporting rules here because the only declared element that directly realizes this decision is the transport output field `bus_rsp_o.ack`, and transport ports and port fields are excluded from reporting.
